tagline: Hand-picked bags, luggage, watches and travel essentials from Amazon India
home_title: CarryPick: bags, luggage, watches, travel essentials and tools for India
home_description: Hand-picked bags, luggage, watches, travel clothes, shoes and sun care from Amazon India, plus airline and train baggage rules, a cabin bag checker and packing lists.

backpacks.name: Backpacks
backpacks.seo_title: Best laptop backpacks and college bags in India
backpacks.intro: Backpacks for college, office and weekend trips. We check laptop size, litres, padding and rain protection.
backpacks.tip: Match the laptop sleeve to your laptop size, and choose 25–30 litres for everyday college use.

luggage.name: Luggage & Trolley Bags
luggage.seo_title: Best trolley bags and cabin luggage in India
luggage.intro: Cabin and check-in trolleys for Indian flights and train journeys.
luggage.tip: Most Indian airlines allow a 7 kg cabin bag. Add length + width + height and check your airline's limit before you buy.

travel-gear.name: Travel Gear
travel-gear.seo_title: Travel accessories: luggage scales, packing cubes and neck pillows
travel-gear.intro: Small things that make trips easier: luggage scales, packing cubes and neck pillows.
travel-gear.tip: Weigh your bag at home before you fly to avoid extra-baggage charges at the airport.

watches.name: Watches
watches.seo_title: Best analog watches for men and women in India
watches.intro: Analog watches for daily wear, office and gifting, from brands with service centres across India.
watches.tip: 30 m water resistance means splash-proof only. Take the watch off before a bath or a swim.

clothing.name: Clothing & Winter Wear
clothing.seo_title: Winter wear and travel clothes in India: thermals, jackets, rain ponchos
clothing.intro: Thermals, jackets, caps and rain gear for hill trips and monsoon travel. We check the fabric, the weight and how to wash it.
clothing.tip: Dress in layers: thermals, then a sweater, then a jacket. Take a layer off before you start to sweat.

shoes.name: Shoes & Sandals
shoes.seo_title: Best travel shoes in India: walking shoes, hiking shoes, sandals and flip-flops
shoes.intro: Shoes for snow, long sightseeing days and the beach. We check what the listing really says about water.
shoes.tip: Wear your heaviest shoes on the flight. They don't count towards your bag's weight.

handbags.name: Handbags & Slings
handbags.seo_title: Handbags, tote bags and sling bags for work and travel in India
handbags.intro: Totes, satchels and crossbody slings for work, sightseeing and flights. We check the size, the weight and how each one closes.
handbags.tip: On some airlines a purse or laptop bag counts inside your 7 kg cabin limit. Check your airline before you pack.

skincare.name: Sun Care & Skincare
skincare.seo_title: Sunscreen and travel-size skincare in India: under 100 ml for your cabin bag
skincare.intro: Sunscreen, lip balm, moisturiser and face wash in sizes that are allowed in your cabin bag. We check the size and the SPF on each listing.
skincare.tip: In a cabin bag, each liquid or cream must be 100 ml or less, and all of them must fit in one clear 1-litre bag.
